title: CBSP21 Patch Manifest v2 (code-analysis-tool)
description: v2 adds only fields required by the pr_scope detector: pinned merge-base identity and a minimum in-scope coverage threshold. All other v1 fields remain.

min_coverage_percent.description: Minimum percentage of merge-base..HEAD changed files that must fall inside the declared scope. 95 is the acceptance-contract floor; this field may only raise the bar (a lower value is rejected here and clamped back to 95 by the detector), and fractional thresholds are not supported.

base.description: Base ref (e.g. "main") that pr_scope passes to `git merge-base HEAD <base>` to compute the actual merge-base. This value is NOT itself compared for drift — declare pinned_merge_base for that.

head.description: Informational record of the reviewed head. pr_scope always diffs against the working checkout's HEAD and does not resolve this field.

pinned_merge_base.description: Optional explicit merge-base SHA. When set, pr_scope compares it against the merge-base actually computed from `base` and raises a HIGH base-drift finding if they differ. When omitted, no drift check runs — omit it only for patches where base movement is acceptable.

changed_files_count.description: Author-declared count of changed files. Recorded for review; pr_scope does not currently reconcile it against the real diff.

changed_files_exact.description: Author-declared exact changed-file list. Recorded for review; pr_scope does not currently reconcile it against the real diff — scope enforcement is driven by scope.paths_in_scope / scope.files_expected_to_change.

file_context_coverage_percent.description: Author's declaration of how much of each touched file's context was actually read before editing (a review-discipline metric, NOT test coverage and NOT the scope-coverage figure pr_scope computes from the diff). pr_scope holds it to the same scope.min_coverage_percent threshold: declaring a low value raises the same HIGH coverage finding, with metadata.triggered_by naming which metric tripped.
